page: Google Cloud Platform a3-ultragpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server designed for high-density compute and parallel processing workloads. It features eight NVIDIA H200 GPUs from the Hopper architecture, providing a total of 1123 GB of VRAM. The host system is powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor with 224 vCPUs and 112 physical cores running at 2.1 GHz, supported by 2952.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 13.18 GB per core. Local storage consists of 12599 GB of NVMe SSD.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier for multi-core processing and memory bandwidth. The stress-ng multi-core CPU performance score is 180093.2, and the passmark CPU score reaches 134560.46, both ranking in the top 10% tier. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only small block cached speeds at 13962.09 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 188.22 GB/sec. Single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core scoring 2143.28, placing it in the middle 50% tier.

This hardware configuration is optimized for large-scale artificial intelligence tasks, including LLM inference, where it achieves 5633.5 tokens/sec for prompt processing on a medium 7B model. The integration of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and massive memory bandwidth also supports intensive database operations, as evidenced by a top-tier Redis SET performance of 203.54 million operations per second. Given the high resource density of eight enterprise-grade GPUs and substantial system memory, this server represents a specialized, high-capital hardware class tailored for deep learning, scientific simulations, and massive parallel data processing.
